svg.title: Goryeo, the Mongol wars and the Japan campaigns
svg.desc: The Korean peninsula and northern Kyushu: Guju and the northern frontier towns, Gaegyeong, Ganghwa, Jindo, Jeju, Haeinsa, Songgwangsa, Happo, Tsushima, Iki and Hakata. The map does not show a reconstructed Goryeo frontier or fleet routes.

g.text: Goryeo, the Mongol wars and the Japan campaigns
Goryeo, the Mongol wars and the Japan campaigns
Fleets sailed from Happo in 1274 and 1281 and landed at Hakata Bay. Open circles: approximate locators.
